# Saturn Ring Lab

Saturn Ring Lab is a sourced guide to Saturn — the planet, its rings, its moons and the missions that studied it — built around six archived Cassini radio observations of the rings. Facts on each section page link to the NASA, JPL or NASA PDS page they were checked against.

Sections:
- Homepage: https://saturnringlab.com/
- The planet (size, interior, weather, seasons, day length, magnetic field): https://saturnringlab.com/planet
- The rings (to-scale ring map, ring and gap radii from the PDS Ring-Moon Systems Node, five guided observations in real Cassini data, open questions): https://saturnringlab.com/rings
- The moons (293 confirmed moons as of August 2026 per NASA; sixteen compared from JPL data, downloadable CSV): https://saturnringlab.com/moons
- Missions (sourced timeline from 1610 to Dragonfly): https://saturnringlab.com/missions
- Explore data: https://saturnringlab.com/data

The data explorer contains six Cassini RSS PDS diffraction-limited profile products: Rev 007, 028, 044, 064, 123, and 133, totaling 1,566,902 converted source rows. The plot supports optical depth, normalized signal power, and phase shift. Wide views are reduced source-sample overviews; narrow windows use hash-verified exact converted records. The 0.25 km sampling interval is not a claim about reconstructed resolution. The measurement lab computes window statistics and gap widths from the exact rows; the site does not run any reconstruction to remove diffraction effects.

My notebook stores visitor observations and drafts in the current browser, with export support. It does not provide account or cloud synchronization.

Data source: https://pds-rings.seti.org/cassini/rss/
Moons table: https://saturnringlab.com/downloads/saturn-major-moons.csv (JPL Solar System Dynamics values; mean elements, not for ephemerides)
Website source: https://github.com/Dellin3/primes-ring-website
The Saturn background is an artistic rendering.

Public observation catalog: https://saturnringlab.com/datasets
- Rev 007 Egress · X-band · DSN 43: https://saturnringlab.com/datasets/rev007e-x43-dlp-500m
- Rev 028 Ingress · X-band · DSN 43: https://saturnringlab.com/datasets/rev028i-x43-dlp-500m
- Rev 044 Egress · X-band · DSN 63: https://saturnringlab.com/datasets/rev044e-x63-dlp-500m
- Rev 064 Egress · X-band · DSN 43: https://saturnringlab.com/datasets/rev064e-x43-dlp-500m
- Rev 123 Egress · X-band · DSN 63: https://saturnringlab.com/datasets/rev123e-x63-dlp-500m
- Rev 133 Egress · X-band · DSN 43: https://saturnringlab.com/datasets/rev133e-x43-dlp-500m

The visitor notebook is browser-local and excluded from public search indexing. These data details describe the archived DLP products, not new high-resolution reconstruction results.
